_comment: Rows of one API entry in the model selector page: the ids a provider listing yields, and the plan drawn from a listing or its fallback. _shared/lua/llm/api_model_listing.lua (macOS and Linux unit suites) and its port in windows/modules/llm/api_remote.ahk (AHK suite) each replay this corpus; tools/test/test-model-selector-page.cjs checks that all three do.

ids.name: gemini names lose their models/ prefix
ids with whitespace, control characters or no text are dropped
a body without its list is unreadable
sambanova listing (recorded)
ids.source: GET https://api.sambanova.ai/v1/models, recorded 2026-10-30 without a key (trimmed)

ids.name: huggingface listing (recorded)
ids.source: GET https://router.huggingface.co/v1/models, recorded 2026-10-30 without a key (trimmed)

plans.name: listed ids, configured model first when the listing omits it
listed ids holding the configured model
refused listing falls back to the known models
a decisions entry keeps its one model and nothing to type

unlisted_providers._comment: Chat providers of api_providers.json with no listing recorded in ids (an ids vector naming a provider is a trimmed listing it answered, with its source), and why. tests/unit/modules/llm/vectors/test_api_provider_catalogue.lua (macOS and Linux) requires one or the other.

unlisted_providers.perplexity: GET <base_url>/models answers 404: Perplexity documents no listing for Sonar chat completions (its /v1/models lists Agent API ids), so the page offers the catalogue models and a typed id.
unlisted_providers.moonshot: Documented as an OpenAI list (platform.kimi.ai docs/api/list-models), but no complete response is published and the route needs a key: none recorded.
unlisted_providers.dashscope: compatible-mode/v1/models answers 401 without a key and its shape is undocumented; the documented listing is the native /api/v1/models (output.models[].model), which the listing reader does not take.
unlisted_providers.zai: Not documented (docs.z.ai API reference); the route answers an authentication error without a key: none recorded.
unlisted_providers.siliconflow: Documented as an OpenAI list (docs.siliconflow.com get-model-list) with field examples only; the route needs a key: none recorded.
